372	## 2026-09-23 — Faster "logged in" on return visits: sonnet vs fable engine
373	Context: card "When I enter the website it takes a long time to see that I am actually logged
374	in" (fullstack, Difficulty override `hard`, title-only spec). Root cause is a post-hydration
375	waterfall in `src/app/providers.tsx` `checkLogin`: Redux starts logged-out, and with a 15-minute
376	access token nearly every return visit does `/me/` (401) → `token/refresh/` (rotation + blacklist
377	write) → `/me/` again, three sequential hops to a cold Vercel serverless Django + Supabase pooler,
378	while `Navigation`/`Landpage` render the guest UI until the last one resolves. Fable was
379	defensible: the fix touches token/session code on the AUTH-9 `risk: high` list, and there are real
380	subtleties — a localStorage read during render is a Next hydration mismatch (must be an effect or
381	a pre-hydration inline script), an optimistic cached user must reconcile without a logout flash,
382	and skipping the dead `/me/` hop means decoding `exp` client-side.
383	Decision: `engineModel: sonnet`, `planModel: fable` (thin spec). The design round can name every
384	mechanism up front — cache the last `/me/` payload under a fixed localStorage key, hydrate the
385	slice optimistically in the mount effect when a refresh token exists, proactively refresh when the
386	access token is expired instead of eating a 401, reconcile with `/me/` in the background, and
387	optionally have `SessionRefreshView` return `user` so it is one hop — each with a done-check.
388	That is long-and-explicit, which is the sonnet row; the AUTH-9 surface is handled by `risk: high`
389	review, not by an engine upgrade.
390	Consequences: auth-bootstrap/perf work stays on sonnet when the design round can pin the
391	hydration-safe read point and the reconcile rules; fable is reserved for cases where the
392	session-state mechanism itself cannot be decided before coding.
393	Design round, same day (`docs/team/designs/2026-09-23-faster-logged-in-state.md`): fourth cloud
394	round with no `Agent` tool and no engine teammates in `ListAgents`, seats filled by the planner
395	from source again. Settled: display-only `nba3via-session-user` cache hydrated via a new
396	`hydrateSession` reducer in the mount effect (never sets `authChecked`); bootstrap decodes `exp`
397	and calls the exported single-flight `refreshSession` directly when expired; `token/refresh/`
398	returns `user`; a 5xx from `/me/` now keeps the session instead of deleting the tokens; a
399	pre-hydration inline script was rejected because `Navigation`'s guest button and user chip are
400	different DOM (the remaining flash is the JS-load window, a follow-up card). Engine stays sonnet.

- **Where the text is:** The landing-page cards (`GameTile`) already never show points: `Landpage.tsx` passes a `pointLabel` like "500 pts", but `GameTile.tsx` never renders it. The points line actually visible under each card is in the game-page "ALL GAMES" sidebar, `src/views/Trivia/MiniGame.tsx:302`, showing "up to N pts" or "soon". That's a one-line change in one file, with no logic.
- **Unclear scope:** The spec is thin. The game header's "up to N pts" chip (`MiniGame.tsx:216`) isn't under a card, so the builder should leave it alone. Whether to also drop the unused `pointLabel` prop is up to the builder under the surgical-changes rule.
